title: Hycroft Manor

buildingCutout.basis: OpenStreetMap names the full building outline, including both covered porticos and the solarium projections.

terrainReference.basis: Original Copernicus GLO-30 at the centerline immediately south of the porte-cochere on the existing driveway. Model foundations step down at the north terrace.

identities.name: Hycroft Manor
identities.address: 1489 McRae Avenue, Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada

mapIdentity.scope: Named OpenStreetMap way 328239442 supplies footprint and orientation. The eastward straight leg of the south elevation defines the authored X axis, and mapped driveway 947534827 locates the portico.

note: The 1927 Leonard Frank photograph and City of Vancouver register description give the principal elevation, Ionic columns, dormers, second floor boxed sills, hipped green-tile roof, deep cornice and projecting chimneys.
